name: Chicken Girls
description: Rhyme and her friends - known by their 'ship name, "The Chicken Girls" - have been dancing together forever. But this year, everything's changing.

videos.title: Forever Team: Do You Remember?
videos.overview: Still reeling from Harmony’s absence, Simone has a rude awakening when she runs into some old friends.

videos.title: Forever Team: Let's Play
videos.overview: Simone and Claire find an exciting new way to spend more time together. Eggie confronts Bel about Vince.

videos.title: Forever Team: Go Time
videos.overview: Simone, Claire and Eggie prepare for the upcoming competition.

videos.title: Forever Team: Far But Never Apart
videos.overview: The Chicken Girls reunite for a thrilling finale.

videos.title: Monday
videos.overview: Rhyme and her friends have always danced together. But this year there's a new girl in town and only three spots on the team.

videos.title: Tuesday
videos.overview: Dance tryouts don't go as expected, and T.K. invites Rhyme to his sister's birthday party.

videos.title: Wednesday
videos.overview: As her friends forge new relationships, Rhyme feels left out.

videos.title: Thursday
videos.overview: As the pep rally approaches, things come to a head for Rhyme, T.K. and the Chicken Girls.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Friends new and old come together for Ace's big bash.

videos.title: Next Crush
videos.overview: After the drama at the Halloween party between the chicken girls we dont know who is still the same and who is changing.

videos.title: Photograph
videos.overview: The dance squad gets a new manager, and Ellie makes a difficult choice.

videos.title: Broken
videos.overview: At the dance expo, the squad goes head to head with Power Surge.

videos.title: Say Anything
videos.overview: Birdie turns up the heat against Power Surge, and Kayla finally comes clean to Ellie.

videos.title: Stronger in Numbers
videos.overview: Birdie is down in the doldrums, and Rhyme tries to patch things up with Quinn.

videos.title: Two Places at Once
videos.overview: Ellie is pulled in two directions, as the Dance Team battles Power Surge in the season finale.

videos.title: Thyme
videos.overview: When school lets out for Ski Week, challenges near and far confront the Chicken Girls.

videos.title: Gone West
videos.overview: The gang encounters new faces in California, while back home a plan is hatched.

videos.title: Surf's Up
videos.overview: Back home, the girls go door-to-door to save the Arcade, while Rhyme and T.K. explore new passions on break.

videos.title: Always a Catch
videos.overview: As vacation comes to a close, the gang faces hard choices and emotional goodbyes.

videos.title: Save the Arcade
videos.overview: With time running out, the girls of Attaway stage a last ditch effort to save the Arcade.

videos.title: Bring It On
videos.overview: It's the first day of but when a new boy roles into town, things start getting a little Rhyme.

videos.title: Flour Babies
videos.overview: The Chicken Girls are assigned an economics project, which causes some drama between the squad.

videos.title: Flew The Coop
videos.overview: One of the Chicken Girls says goodbye to Attaway.

videos.title: The Future is Female
videos.overview: Rhyme Accidentally becomes the leader of Attaway's feminist movements.

videos.title: The Stench
videos.overview: The Attaway Appeal investigates a mysterious school-wide stench.

videos.title: Cancelled
videos.overview: The Chicken Girls are fed up with the boys in their lives.

videos.title: You're Invited
videos.overview: Ronney's birthday party provokes a whirlwind of break-ups and make-ups.

videos.title: Teacher Takeover
videos.overview: The romantic confusion between Rhyme, Ronney, and Drake reaches a tipping point.

videos.title: Battle of the Classes
videos.overview: It's a Battle of the Classes and tempers flare on and off the field between Rhyme & Ezra, Ty & Luna, and Rooney & Drake. Also - be on the lookout for a new (but familiar) face in the halls of Attaway High!

videos.title: Mr. Attaway
videos.overview: Attaway's pageant for boys has Ezra, Hamilton, Jax (Alex Guzman), and Tim vying for the title of Mr. Attaway. While competition heats up on-stage, off-stage, Rhyme and Rooney begin reconsidering the state of their relationships.

videos.title: Sincerely, Rhyme
videos.overview: The season finale of Chicken Girls finds Rhyme taking a hard look at her relationship with Ezra while Rooney considers a new love interest.

videos.title: The Other Guy
videos.overview: It's a new semester at Attaway and that means new drama and new crushes .

videos.title: You're Hired
videos.overview: Rhyme's cousin, Astrid takes revisits her past in Attaway. Meanwhile, Rooney begins to question the state of her love life.

videos.title: Great Debate
videos.overview: Quinn has a tough time moving on after her break-up with Hamilton. Meanwhile, new texts shed light on Rooney's dilemma with Stephanie.

videos.title: Game Day
videos.overview: Tensions rise in Attaway as Rhyme adjusts to being in the shadow of her cousin's newfound popularity and Ty steps back on the football field after a season-ending injury.

videos.title: Pinky Promise
videos.overview: It's a whirlwind day in Attaway. Rhyme and Astrid try to set aside their disagreements, Rooney looks for a way to cope with her heartbreak and burgeoning identity, and Ellie does her best to help Quinn get over Hamilton.

videos.title: The Trenches
videos.overview: It's a whirlwind of drama in Attaway as Rooney tries to patch things up with two of the people she cares about most and Rhyme does her best to put family before feels.

videos.title: Three Knocks
videos.overview: It's a special spooky Halloween edition of Chicken Girls! Astrid tells a scary story that sends shivers down everyone's spines. But when the story gets a little too real, so does the drama.

videos.title: Profound Romantic Undertones
videos.overview: The truth comes out when Rooney makes an important announcement in front of everyone at her photo gallery -- and Rhyme confronts her own drama.

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: Harmony encounters new friends, drama, and boy problems when she returns back to Attaway.

videos.title: Boy Troubles
videos.overview: With the pressure on, Harmony runs into some trouble with the dance team and Leyla gets asked out by a cute eighth grader.

videos.title: Group Project
videos.overview: Claire’s big secret is revealed, and P. K. seeks help with girl problems.

videos.title: Pep Rally
videos.overview: At the group date, Harmony gives Claire a makeover.

videos.title: Girls' Day
videos.overview: Rhyme takes Harmony and her friends for a day on the town.

videos.title: Team Manager
videos.overview: Bel gives Harmony an ultimatum, while TK. takes his cousin under his wing.

videos.title: Chowder Bake
videos.overview: Bel and Eggie confront their feelings at their family’s annual get-together.

videos.title: Over the Rainbow
videos.overview: Tensions boil over at the annual Halloween dance, and an old friend resurfaces.

videos.title: Truce
videos.overview: Tensions boil over at the annual Halloween dance, and an old friend resurfaces.

videos.title: A Girl Named Claire
videos.overview: Rhyme stresses over college apps, while Claire gets a local history lesson.

videos.title: Hey Harmony
videos.overview: After a technical malfunction, Leyla and Harmony team up to fix the Attaway Appeal website.

videos.title: Operation Spider
videos.overview: Bel and Harmony hatch a plan to get back at the Millwood team.

videos.title: Breakfast Club
videos.overview: In detention, the girls put aside their differences.

videos.title: Regionals
videos.overview: Tempers flare as the A Team and Millwood face off at Regionals and the boys have an eye-opening camping trip that has everyone choosing sides.

videos.title: Attaway Day
videos.overview: In the season finale, Harmony finds her flock, while Rhyme reconnects with old friends.

videos.title: The Burn
videos.overview: Spring semester gets off to a tumultuous start when The Chicken Girls and Power Surge face off at dance tryouts.

videos.title: Decisions, Decisions
videos.overview: Harmony and Bel contemplate their futures while Claire faces an unexpected challenger in her campaign. Leyla meets a new friend at the Appeal.

videos.title: Leo's Return
videos.overview: While Leo McCoy’s return to Attaway stirs up plenty of drama; Claire and PK disagree about campaign strategy and Harmony searches for a new extra-curricular.

videos.title: Wacky Wednesday
videos.overview: When Bel is embarrassed by Power Surge, she finds an unlikely ally in Leo. Meanwhile, Harmony and Jordan’s relationship is tested when Harmony joins the drama club.

videos.title: Campaign Speeches
videos.overview: The election heats up after Claire’s disastrous campaign speeches leaves Eggie in the lead. Harmony makes a hard choice to save her relationship.

videos.title: All's Fair In Love and Politics
videos.overview: Harmony frets about her first stage kiss with Leo while Claire resorts to dirty politics to pull ahead of Eggie in the election.

videos.title: Bake Sale
videos.overview: The drama club holds a bake sale fundraiser and gets more than they bargained for when secrets come to the surface. Leyla makes an unexpected connection.

videos.title: The Understudy
videos.overview: Bel finds a new calling while Leyla and Harmony grapple with the events of the bake sale. And as the play gets closer, shake ups at rehearsal have everyone on edge.

videos.title: The Debate
videos.overview: Whether it’s romantic tension or passionate disagreement,  all the drama comes to a head when Leyla confronts Simone and Claire and Eggie face off at the debates.

videos.title: Midsummer
videos.overview: The drama club performs, but the real drama happens offstage. Eggie and Simone make a decision about their future, while Leo faces a crossroads.

videos.title: Rough Start
videos.overview: Harmony hopes to make Rhyme’s last night before cheer camp perfect, but Rhyme has other plans. Meanwhile, Eggie struggles with his feelings for Claire, and a new girl in Attaway stirs up trouble.

videos.title: On The Hunt
videos.overview: With their eyes set on Los Angeles, the Chicken Girls are on the hunt for summer jobs. Bel meets a cute boy at the country club and a surprising new coworker might turn Leyla off ice cream forever.

videos.title: Working Girls
videos.overview: While Harmony has her hands full with the Hansons, Leyla butts heads with her new coworker and  Claire and Bel struggle to fit in at Crown Lake.

videos.title: Dangerous Waters
videos.overview: As Bel navigates the unwritten rules of the country club, Leyla navigates work with Simone — and a difficult decision. Meanwhile, Harmony realizes the Hansons may be more complicated than they seem.

videos.title: Secrets and Sleepovers
videos.overview: Leyla and Harmony plan a fun day for Judy while Claire bonds with Grace and fantasizes about her past. And though Katie and Simone think Tamara’s up to no good; she’s definitely not the only one with a secret.

videos.title: Significant Others
videos.overview: Bel and Ernie have their first date while Simone encounters a ghost from Leyla’s past that leaves her questioning their relationship. Harmony discovers more secrets about the Hansons when she visits Claire at Crown Lake Country Club.

videos.title: Rites and Revelations
videos.overview: TK and PK kidnap Harmony for a fun adventure, but the day takes a dark turn. Claire gets to know a different side of Crown Lake during the Rite of Summer. For Leyla, car shopping with her mom is more revealing than expected.

videos.title: Truth and Lies
videos.overview: Leyla and Simone face tension at work and Harmony steps into some drama while covering for Bel at the country club. And though Bel planned the perfect surprise for Ernie’s birthday, she ends up being the one in shock.

videos.title: Los Angeles
videos.overview: Harmony travels to Los Angeles to see Rhyme, and learns that what she needs has been in Attaway all along.

videos.title: The Ball
videos.overview: Harmony tries to set everything right with her friends in time for the country club’s summer ball — which could be a night for all the Chicken Girls to remember.

videos.title: New Kids On The Block
videos.overview: New students from San Francisco make waves at Attaway. Harmony finds a mysterious drone.

videos.title: Investigative Reporting
videos.overview: Harmony and Leyla investigate the new kids. Gus tries to make a move on Yasmina.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: Yasmina one-ups Claire at a student council meeting. Bel surprises Ernie at the dealership.

videos.title: Hot Off The Press
videos.overview: Leyla becomes a mini-celeb after her article is published and Claire learns how to be chill.

videos.title: The Break In
videos.overview: Harmony starts to worry about Coach Coop as Leyla takes her investigation to the next level.

videos.title: Fall Out
videos.overview: Claire and Bel force their boyfriends to call a truce. Harmony and Simone face off at Vanilla and Sage.

videos.title: The Big Game
videos.overview: Tensions come to a head during the Attaway vs. Crown Lake soccer game.

videos.title: No Place Like Home
videos.overview: As everyone finally rallies together after the fallout of the soccer game, shocking news leaves Harmony worried about her future.

videos.title: Selling Attaway?
videos.overview: As the SF crowd continues to take over Attaway, Harmony and the Chicken Girls find themselves up against overwhelming changes.

videos.title: Fresh Faces
videos.overview: Claire steps down from her presidency and the soccer team gets a new coach.

videos.title: Material Girls
videos.overview: Harmony hatches a plan to scare away potential buyers for her home as Simone confronts her anger issues.

videos.title: Nothing Stays The Same
videos.overview: Changes at Attaway come to a head as the soccer and dance teams rally for a victory.

videos.title: Change Can Be Good?
videos.overview: Harmony tries to convince her mom to reconsider selling, Simone and Leyla’s relationship hits a roadblock.

videos.title: Forget Me Not
videos.overview: A familiar face gives Harmony some much needed advice as she finds herself at a crossroads. PK and his mom have trouble on the field.

videos.title: Everybody Hurts
videos.overview: Relationship troubles brew for the girls while Harmony struggles to bring up her impending move.

videos.title: So Long
videos.overview: Harmony bids goodbye to Attaway.

videos.title: Spin, Ballerina
videos.overview: Ex-ballerina Ivy contemplates her future as she starts school at Attaway.

videos.title: Real Player
videos.overview: Ivy and Kara have creative differences. J.J. tries to get on the dance team. Bailey is dealt a major blow.

videos.title: In or Out?
videos.overview: Ivy overhears Kara doubting her dedication to the team. Bailey attempts to get back on the football team. Kara finds solace somewhere unexpected.

videos.title: Second Try
videos.overview: Bailey debates her next steps. Kara and Ben deal with their budding feelings for each other. Ivy gets closer to Theo and grows suspicious of Petra.

videos.title: Keeping a Secret
videos.overview: Simone suspects that Ivy has a crush on Theo. Things between Kara and Ben heat up.

videos.title: Team!
videos.overview: As Kara plays hooky from school, the dance team gains a new member.

videos.title: Better Off
videos.overview: Bailey catches on to J.J.’s living situation. Petra and Ivy spend more time together. Ben and Kara make a decision about their future.

videos.title: Play Pretend
videos.overview: Ivy and Finn go on a double date with Theo and Petra. Bailey pushes the boundaries in her friendship with J.J.

videos.title: Misstep
videos.overview: Bailey feels guilty about her actions. Ivy and Finn get closer. J.J. deals with a new challenge.

videos.title: The Key
videos.overview: Ivy and Finn put on a show to sell their relationship. Kara organizes a bake sale to pay for the dance team’s expenses. Theo starts to realize his feelings for Ivy.

videos.title: Just Your Type
videos.overview: Ivy deals with the aftermath of her PDA at Junior’s. Finn receives bad news. Bailey finds a unique solution for Ben.

videos.title: Cover Blown
videos.overview: Simone struggles to keep her grades up but Poppy has the perfect solution for her. Tensions rise between Theo and Ivy. Finn and Kara make a startling discovery.

videos.title: Traitor
videos.overview: Kara and Finn come to J.J.’s aide. Ivy confronts Petra. Bailey learns a devastating truth.

videos.title: It’s Personal
videos.overview: As Petra ices Ivy out, Ivy finds a friend in Kara. Bailey leans on Sage for support. J.J. enlists Finn’s help around the Alvarez house.

videos.title: Miracles
videos.overview: Petra deals with the consequences of getting caught. Theo pushes Ivy away. Finn looks into J.J.’s past.

videos.title: The Exposé
videos.overview: After the story about the football team’s sabotage comes out, Bailey has to make a choice. Ivy and Finn discuss the future of their ‘fake’ relationship. Kara’s guilt about keeping secrets from Bailey eats at her.

videos.title: Plan B
videos.overview: With the dance team’s future at Regionals uncertain, Kara takes matters into her own hands and rallies the troops. Ivy’s health takes a downward turn.

videos.title: Regionals
videos.overview: The dance team gears up for Regionals but as secrets spill and past mistakes come to light, not all goes to plan.

videos.title: Onward
videos.overview: Dealt a blow at Regionals, Ivy recovers at home while still torn between Finn and Theo. Ben corners Kara at the Homecoming dance.

videos.title: Long Live
videos.overview: Ivy reads Finn’s letter. Simone and the girls reflect on past years. J.J. receives shocking, life changing news.

videos.title: Claire’s Hidden Secrets Amid Divorce Drama
videos.overview: Claire goes to dramatic lengths to keep her friend group together while keeping her parent’s divorce a secret.

videos.title: Head to Head
videos.overview: When Simone and Isla find out there’s an open spot on the Varsity team, they go to extreme lengths in order to keep their tryouts a secret from one another.

videos.title: She Caught Her Boyfriend LYING!
videos.overview: When Claire suspects her new boyfriend is being unfaithful, she tries to sneak a peek at his phone, risking their relationship.

videos.title: Crush REJECTS Her for Being Too Short?
videos.overview: When Aria’s insecurities threaten to ruin her confidence before a date with her crush, Claire and the Chicken Girls take it upon themselves to help her out. But when their makeover leaves Aria more flustered than before, she might just lose her chance...

videos.title: She Took PILLS To Study!
videos.overview: When she fails a pop quiz, Simone’s hopes of spending time with her crush on a school trip are in jeopardy. Desperate to be able to focus on her studies, Simone takes a huge risk and buys study drugs to help her with her school work.

videos.title: Nervous Girl SCARED For FIRST KISS
videos.overview: When Sara gets invited to hang out with her crush, she pushes aside her anxiety and agrees to go. But when Sara finds herself alone with her crush for the first time, she worries that they might be taking things too fast.

videos.title: She Used MAGIC on Her Boyfriend, Instantly Regrets It!
videos.overview: When her long distance boyfriend starts ignoring her texts, Bel consults teen witch Clover to help and Clover does a spell to reveal Bel's perfect match.

videos.title: Mean Girls RUIN Her Birthday Party
videos.overview: When she finds out that Kiki’s not having a birthday party, Claire takes it upon herself to throw her a surprise party – only to learn that Kiki’s classmates find her annoying!

videos.title: Girl Goes VIRAL, Gets Bullied For It
videos.overview: When Claire’s heat-of-the-moment speech about the misogyny surrounding Halloween costumes goes viral, she starts getting harassed by online trolls.

videos.title: Chicken Girls’ Secrets Exposed
videos.overview: When deep dark secrets about the Chicken Girls start spreading around school, the girls turn on each other, thinking there's a traitor in their midst.
